items.title: Developer adoption is now a separate, unrun validation step

source.label: Private Nisi roadmap

metricDefinitions.label: Unaided useful-task completion
metricDefinitions.definition: The planned measure counts eligible started trials that finish a task, pass the fixed acceptance check and demonstrate report understanding without out-of-protocol help.

metricDefinitions.label: Setup and integration effort
metricDefinitions.definition: The planned diagnostics record hands-on setup and debugging, end-to-end elapsed time, assistance and the integration work needed for an initial and second task.

caveats: No developer trial or baseline measurement has been run; no numerical adoption or time-saving target is established.
Assisted, failed and timed-out eligible trials remain recorded. One tester does not establish broad demand.
An AI or author rehearsal is not independent human usability evidence.

items.title: External testing and public changes remain approval-gated

queries.summary: The plan permits private trial preparation, not recruitment or transmission of the confidential merged implementation.

source.label: Private Nisi development boundaries
caveats: The existing exact-artifact legal and engineering gates plus scoped disclosure approval still apply.
The description experimental developer library does not authorize publication of the private merger.
